contentPattern.structure: cover image + breadcrumbs + h1 title + byline + date + read-time + topic tag

suitableFor: individual blog post / article detail pages
news article detail pages with cover image + title + byline + meta + tag
case study detail pages with similar header structure
notSuitableFor: blog listing / index pages with CTAs (use hero-blog)
full-bleed image banners with text overlay (use hero-banner)
homepage hero with stacked image gallery (use hero-trendsetters)
